_comment: GameOfPureStrategy locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the bracketed card tokens (e.g. [A], [10], [Q], [K]) or the '### ' markdown and '->' symbols.

_slots.{prize}: The revealed prize card's face label (A, 2..10, J, Q, K) - do not translate
_slots.{worth}: The prize's total value including any carried-over pot
_slots.{hand}: The player's remaining cards, rendered as bracketed tokens like '[A]' '[2]' - do not translate
_slots.{bid0}: Player 0's played card face label - do not translate
_slots.{bid1}: Player 1's played card face label - do not translate
_slots.{outcome}: The rendered round-outcome phrase (who won or the tie result)
_slots.{pot}: The pot value awarded or carried over this round
_slots.{s}: The tied final score both players reached

player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a match of GameOfPureStrategy.
- You hold the 13 cards A-K; each can be used once.
- Each round a prize card is revealed. Play exactly ONE card by writing something that contains a bracketed token like '[Q]', '[10]', '[2]' ...
- Higher card wins the prize (plus carry-over). Ties roll prize into the pot for next round.
- Highest total after 13 rounds wins.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Action must contain exactly ONE bracketed card token.
invalid_move.no_card: You no longer have that card.
